key_idea: Anna moves around the wheel the same number of seats, in the same direction, as Ben.
steps: Anna (pink) is at the top. Ben (blue) is in the seat to the upper left of her.
The arrow turns the wheel to the right. Ben moves 1 seat, up to the top where Anna was.
Anna moves 1 seat the same way, from the top to the upper right seat.
So Ben is at the top and Anna is at the upper right.

choice_feedback.A: Ben is at the top, but Anna moved 2 seats here. She should move just 1 seat.
choice_feedback.B: Anna is still at the top here. Ben should be at the top now.
choice_feedback.D: Anna moved to the left here. The wheel turns to the right.
choice_feedback.E: Ben is not at the top here, but he should be in Anna's old seat.
